purpose: Quality non-inferiority and economy thresholds for routing evals, fixed before any measurement (request §82, TODO-013, TODO-017). Edits after a recorded measurement invalidate the predeclaration.

telemetry_contract.units: native only: tokens, credits, quota fraction; usd only when the provider reports it

validated_success_rate.definition: cases whose final attempt has validation_pass=true divided by cases attempted

first_attempt_validated_success.definition: cases with validation_pass=true on the attempt with retry_count=0

attempts_per_validated.definition: attempts across all worker kinds divided by validated results

under_routing_rate.definition: candidate cases routed below the case minimum acceptable route, or failing validation where main validated with a higher tier

cost_per_validated_result.definition: routing_telemetry.rollup per_validated_result, summing root, subagent, retry, diagnostic and summary kinds

latency_p95.definition: 95th percentile wall-clock latency per validated case

regression_margin.rule: one-sided 95% lower confidence bound (Newcombe hybrid score) of candidate minus main must be >= -0.02 in every reported segment; first_attempt_validated_success uses the same bound with margin 0.05
regression_margin.rationale: Validated completion is the product; savings never buy a measurable drop in it.
regression_margin.why_conservative: Common non-inferiority margins are 5-10 points; 2 points applied to the confidence bound, not the point estimate, makes the candidate prove non-inferiority instead of merely not appearing worse, and an underpowered run fails.

under_routing_limit.rule: zero candidate routes below a case minimum acceptable route in any segment; failure-attributed under-routing rate <= 0.02 with one-sided 95% upper bound <= 0.05
under_routing_limit.rationale: Under-routing fails silently and costs retries, diagnosis and trust; floors are deterministic so any violation is a policy defect, not noise.
under_routing_limit.why_conservative: A single floor violation fails the gate regardless of savings, and the attributed-failure limit is checked on its upper bound so small samples cannot hide it.

material_gain.unit: relative reduction in one native unit
material_gain.rule: candidate reduces cost per validated result by >= 15% in input_tokens+output_tokens or in credits, while no other reported native unit and attempts_per_validated rise by more than 5% and latency_p95 rises by no more than 25%
material_gain.rationale: Routing changes carry switching, cache-affinity and review cost; only a clear native-unit saving justifies them (request §82: material economic gain).
material_gain.why_conservative: 15% sits above typical run-to-run token variance for agentic tasks, and the no-shift guard blocks savings that only move cost into retries, cache writes or another unit. No USD conversion is used to manufacture a gain.

minimum_sample.rule: a segment with fewer samples is reported as inconclusive and cannot pass any gate; matched runs pair main and candidate on the same case and cache state
minimum_sample.rationale: Below these counts the confidence bounds are too wide to support a non-inferiority claim.
minimum_sample.why_conservative: Inconclusive is treated as fail, so missing data can only keep the current main policy.

safe_segments.rule: auto-routing may be enabled only in listed segments after every gate passes there; floor_locked, guarded and resilience stay shadow-only regardless of results until a new predeclaration widens the list
safe_segments.rationale: TODO-013 starts with strong deterministic validation plus low or medium blast radius and expands only by evidence.
safe_segments.why_conservative: Exactly one segment is eligible, the one where a wrong route is caught by deterministic validation before it ships.

decision_rule: A candidate policy passes in a segment only when minimum_sample, regression_margin, under_routing_limit and material_gain all pass there and the segment is listed in safe_segments; any failed or inconclusive gate keeps the main policy.
